title: X0XFailureLog
description: Deterministic disclosure of catalog-gap findings that Panopticon retained in its main report but could not represent in X0X because they had no file locus.

discarded_findings.description: One row per discarded finding. This is an array rather than an id-keyed object because distinct findings may share a content-derived id.

finding_id.description: Bounded, redacted and inert spelling of the source finding id, or ? when absent.

reason.description: Stable machine-readable reason the finding cannot become an occurrence-bearing X0X candidate.

diagnostic.description: Bounded, redacted, single-line and inert operator diagnostic.
